title: Wall-Clock Duration Admitted Set
description: Strict admission contract for the per-cell wall-clock duration labels written to data/local_labels/duration_admitted.json by tools/local_labels/duration_repeatability_aggregator.py. The label is the non-root CUPTI dual-source duration_ns (CUPTI Activity duration_ns reconciled against cudaEventElapsedTime), never an NCU gpu__time_duration value: duration_label_source is pinned to the cupti_dual_source const so an NCU-sourced label cannot validate. Each entry carries the (arch, slug, shape_point) cell key plus the runner-joinable provenance (binary_sha256, source_commit, kernel_signature_sha256, cupti_collector_binary_sha256, consumed cupti_sidecar_sha256s), the across-repeat duration summary (median_duration_ns, robust_cv, stddev_duration_ns, mad_duration_ns), the gate basis used (robust coefficient of variation for normal-length kernels, absolute jitter floor for short kernels), an NVML covariate summary, and the schema_version=1 const pin. additionalProperties:false at every layer makes any unknown field a contract break. This is the ground-truth label artifact for an empirical wall-clock duration predictor; it is not a microarchitectural model.

schema_version.description: Pinned at 1. Bumped only on a parse-time-breaking change (renamed/removed required field); additive optional fields do not bump it per the repository wire-extension policy.

cells.description: List of admitted duration-label cells. The aggregator emits one entry per (arch, slug, shape_point) cell that clears the reconciliation, repeat-count, and robust-variance gates.

schema_version.description: Per-record pin to keep stale-shape records from creeping in via raw concatenation. Bumped in lockstep with the file-level schema_version.

slug.description: Kernel slug from the workload roster (e.g. rmsnorm_fwd_bf16). One leg of the (arch, slug, shape_point) cell key.

shape_point.description: Shape-file row identifier the cell ran with.

arch.description: Compute-capability tag of the local device. The active expansion is sm_120-only; sm_86 is admitted by the same schema for a separate-host run.

binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the kernel runner binary used in this cell's timing run.

source_commit.description: git rev-parse HEAD at the time of the CUPTI timing collection, captured by the per-launch duration_run_manifest.

kernel_signature_sha256.description: Stable per-kernel hash mirroring run_suite.py's kernel-signature inputs.

cupti_collector_binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the cupti_activity_collector that emitted the consumed sidecars. Must agree across the cell's sidecars; a disagreement is a typed provenance exclusion.

cupti_sidecar_sha256s.description: SHA-256 of each consumed per-launch CUPTI Activity sidecar (canonical bytes). Pins the exact measurement evidence behind the admitted label.

duration_label_source.description: Pinned source of the duration label: CUPTI Activity duration_ns reconciled against cudaEventElapsedTime. The const makes an NCU gpu__time_duration label non-validating; the aggregator rejects NCU-sourced input upstream with a typed reason.

n_reconciled_repeats.description: Number of distinct repeats whose CUPTI/host dual-source timestamps reconciled and contributed to the cell summary. The aggregator gates a cell on N >= min_reconciled_repeats (pinned at 5 in duration_repeatability_acceptance.toml).

median_duration_ns.description: Median across-repeat CUPTI duration_ns (nanoseconds). The label the duration predictor is scored against.

robust_cv.description: Robust coefficient of variation = (1.4826 * median-absolute-deviation) / median_duration_ns. For normal-length kernels the cell is admitted only when robust_cv <= cv_ceiling.

stddev_duration_ns.description: Sample standard deviation of the per-repeat duration_ns (nanoseconds). For short kernels the cell is admitted only when stddev_duration_ns <= short_kernel_abs_jitter_floor_ns.

mad_duration_ns.description: Median absolute deviation of the per-repeat duration_ns (nanoseconds); the robust spread that backs robust_cv.

short_kernel.description: True when median_duration_ns is below short_kernel_ns_threshold, so the cell was gated on absolute jitter instead of robust_cv (the robust ratio is unstable at small denominators).

gate_basis.description: Which variance gate admitted the cell: robust_cv for normal-length kernels, short_kernel_abs_jitter for short kernels.

nvml_covariate_summary.description: Across-repeat summary of the read-only NVML covariates (clock/thermal/power) aligned to the cell's launches. Records nvml_available=false with null medians when no NVML samples were collected for the cell.

evidence_kind.description: Provenance classifier. 'live' is the only value the aggregator emits from a real CUPTI sweep; 'synthetic' is reserved for fixtures that exercise the wire format without standing in as evidence.

nvml_available.description: True when at least one repeat carried NVML covariate samples aligned to its launch window.

n_repeats_with_nvml.description: Number of reconciled repeats that contributed NVML covariate samples.

temp_c_median.description: Median across-repeat GPU temperature (Celsius), or null when no NVML samples were available.

power_mw_median.description: Median across-repeat board power draw (milliwatts), or null when unavailable.

sm_clock_mhz_median.description: Median across-repeat SM clock (MHz), or null when unavailable.

mem_clock_mhz_median.description: Median across-repeat memory clock (MHz), or null when unavailable.
